responsibility: This header declares the broad C interface for gm2 type construction and type queries. It includes prototypes for building arrays, sets, records, variants, enumerations, pointers, subranges, constructors, function types, and declarations of known types; initialization of built-in Modula-2 and system types; type-range and signedness helpers; and getters for the many canonical predefined type nodes maintained by m2type.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2type family: unlike m2type.def’s Modula-2-facing definition module, it declares the extern C-style prototypes, constructor typedef, and include/visibility macros used by gm2 GCC sources to call the implementation in m2type.cc.
